ENDPOINT=$(az cognitiveservices account show -n contoso-ai -g rg-ai901 --query properties.endpoint -o tsv)
KEY=$(az cognitiveservices account keys list -n contoso-ai -g rg-ai901 --query key1 -o tsv)

  -H "Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"inputs":[{"url":"https://contoso.example/invoices/inv-1001.pdf"}]}'

$endpoint = (Get-AzCognitiveServicesAccount -ResourceGroupName rg-ai901 -Name contoso-ai).Endpoint
$key = (Get-AzCognitiveServicesAccountKey -ResourceGroupName rg-ai901 -Name contoso-ai).Key1

  -Headers @{ 'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key' = $key } -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"inputs":[{"url":"https://contoso.example/invoices/inv-1001.pdf"}]}'
$op = $r.Headers['Operation-Location']
do { Start-Sleep 2; $res = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$op" -Headers @{ 'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key' = $key } } while ($res.status -notin 'Succeeded','Failed')
$res.result.contents[0].fields
ai901-content-understanding.python:
# pip install requests
import os, time, requests

endpoint = os.environ["CU_ENDPOINT"].rstrip("/")  # https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com
headers = {"Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": os.environ["CU_KEY"], "Content-Type": "application/json"}
url = f"{endpoint}/contentunderstanding/analyzers/prebuilt-invoice:analyze?api-version=2025-11-01"

resp = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json={"inputs": [{"url": "https://contoso.example/invoices/inv-1001.pdf"}]})
resp.raise_for_status()  # expect 202 Accepted
operation = resp.headers["Operation-Location"]

while True:
    result = requests.get(operation, headers=headers).json()
    if result["status"] in ("Succeeded", "Failed"):
        break
    time.sleep(2)

for name, field in result["result"]["contents"][0].get("fields", {}).items():
    print(name, field.get("valueString") or field.get("valueNumber") or field.get("valueDate"), field.get("confidence"))

ai901-sdk-agents.python:
# pip install "azure-ai-projects>=2.3.0" azure-identity
import os
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
from azure.ai.projects import AIProjectClient

project = AIProjectClient(
    endpoint=os.environ["FOUNDRY_PROJECT_ENDPOINT"],  # https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>
    credential=DefaultAzureCredential(),
)
openai = project.get_openai_client()

history = []
while True:
    text = input("You: ")
    if not text:
        break
    history.append({"role": "user", "content": text})
    response = openai.responses.create(
        model="chat-model",  # your deployment name
        instructions="You are Contoso's returns assistant. Answer in at most three sentences.",
        input=history,
    )
    print("Assistant:", response.output_text)
    history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": response.output_text})

# ---- Agent: create once, then chat with it
from azure.ai.projects.models import PromptAgentDefinition

agent = project.agents.create_version(
    agent_name="policy-agent",
    definition=PromptAgentDefinition(model="chat-model", instructions="Answer HR questions briefly. Say when you are unsure."),
)
agent_client = project.get_openai_client(agent_name="policy-agent")
conversation = agent_client.conversations.create()
reply = agent_client.responses.create(conversation=conversation.id, input="How many vacation days do new staff get?")
print(reply.output_text)

# pip install azure-cognitiveservices-speech azure-ai-textanalytics
import os
import azure.cognitiveservices.speech as speechsdk
from azure.ai.textanalytics import TextAnalyticsClient
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential

speech_config = speechsdk.SpeechConfig(subscription=os.environ["SPEECH_KEY"], endpoint=os.environ["ENDPOINT"])
speech_config.speech_recognition_language = "en-US"
recognizer = speechsdk.SpeechRecognizer(speech_config=speech_config,
                                        audio_config=speechsdk.audio.AudioConfig(use_default_microphone=True))
result = recognizer.recognize_once_async().get()
if result.reason == speechsdk.ResultReason.RecognizedSpeech:
    text = result.text
    language = TextAnalyticsClient(os.environ["ENDPOINT"], AzureKeyCredential(os.environ["SPEECH_KEY"]))
    sentiment = language.analyze_sentiment([text])[0]
    print(text, "->", sentiment.sentiment, sentiment.confidence_scores)

    speech_config.speech_synthesis_voice_name = "en-US-Ava:DragonHDLatestNeural"
    speechsdk.SpeechSynthesizer(speech_config=speech_config).speak_text_async(f"You sounded {sentiment.sentiment}.").get()
else:
    print("No speech recognized:", result.reason)

import base64
# Describe an image (openai = project.get_openai_client())
with open("car.jpg", "rb") as f:
    data_uri = "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode()
response = openai.responses.create(
    model="chat-model",  # a vision-capable deployment
    input=[{"role": "user", "content": [
        {"type": "input_text", "text": "List the damaged parts and rate severity low/medium/high as JSON."},
        {"type": "input_image", "image_url": data_uri},
    ]}],
)
print(response.output_text)

# Generate an image

    f.write(base64.b64decode(image.data[0].b64_json))
